title: Duckling with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE94A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F2C200'/>

    <radialGradient id='head' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF06A'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='20' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <ellipse cx='36' cy='72' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#E8B800'/>

  <path d='M74 66 Q86 60 80 72 Q74 76 72 74 Z' fill='#E8B800'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M42 88 L36 92 M42 88 L42 94 M42 88 L48 92' stroke='#FF8A1F' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <circle cx='43.5' cy='35' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='35' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='39.5' r='0.9' fill='#CFF6FF'/>
  <circle cx='54.5' cy='39.5' r='0.9' fill='#CFF6FF'/>
